connector.name: Algenta MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Governed data discovery, exact queries, decisions, simulations, and runtime utilities over MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.algenta.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package algenta-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the thyn-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <ALGENTA_API_KEY>. Create a key in the Algenta dashboard or authenticate with `algenta login`.

env.name: ALGENTA_API_KEY
env.description: Your Algenta API key. Create one in the Algenta dashboard or authenticate with `algenta login`.

env.name: ALGENTA_BASE_URL
env.description: Algenta engine base URL. Cloud Managed default; set your own for self-hosted / air-gapped.
